subject: Re: Unexpected withholding on April invoice - usage attribution question
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@brightcart.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected withholding on April invoice - usage attribution question

Hey Jordan / Ben,

We put the April invoice on hold while we sort a withholding tax issue with our accounting team. The dashboard shows a ~14% higher ingest/embedding mix for our staging namespace (brightcart-staging) vs prod for the billing period — that bumped our VAT/withholding calculations unexpectedly. I attached a quick meter snapshot and the PO for the period so you can see what we sent.

Questions from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a per-namespace attribution export (raw request_ids + timestamps) for April 14-20?
- Do you have guidance on tax credit documentation we can provide to our AP team to release payment (they asked for proof of exported tokens tied to prod only)?

We're trying to avoid a month-long hold if possible — can you prioritize a short export or a reconciliation summary we can attach to our AP ticket?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director of Finance, BrightCart
attachments: BrightCart_Metering_Snapshot.csv (csv), Signed_PO_0419.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected withholding on April invoice - usage attribution question

Samir — really sorry to see the hold. We're happy to help get this unstuck. A couple quick notes: we can generate a per-namespace request-sample CSV that includes request_id, namespace_tag, model, tokens_in, tokens_out and timestamp. That should satisfy most AP teams.

Before I run the full export, two clarifying asks so we scope it correctly:
1) Do you need data for the whole billing window (Apr 1-30) or only the suspicious Apr 14-20 range?
2) Is BrightCart refusing remittance entirely (so we should issue a proforma credit) or is this a documentation hold and they intend to release once reconciled?

Ben — looping you in to confirm if there were any known double-ingest risks from our side (staging key reuse, replay jobs) during mid-April.

If you can confirm, I can get ops to produce the sample export this afternoon and include a short reconciliation note for your AP.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected withholding on April invoice - quick internal check

Jordan — quick internal note before we release anything to the customer. I pulled the mid-April ingestion logs and saw a small batch replay from a partner integration job on 2026-04-17 that re-ran ~120k requests with the staging API key. That would inflate the staging bucket but shouldn't touch prod.

I'm going to flag ops to export request-level rows for Apr 14-18 for both staging and prod namespaces so we can show clear separation. Lauren, can you prep the reconciliation blurb for AP that explains the replay and confirms the affected counts? Keep it short (one paragraph) and include the number delta and confirmation that token charges only apply to the staging key during the replay window.

Ben
Senior Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, finance@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected withholding on April invoice - usage attribution question

Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the snapshot. Quick summary of what we've done and next steps: 

- Root cause: internal replay from your partner integration on 2026-04-17 re-ran ~120,432 requests under the staging API key; those are the extra tokens showing in the snapshot.
- Evidence: attached CSV export (per your request) with columns request_id, namespace_tag, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp. I've highlighted rows 14-24 which are the replayed batch.
- AP-friendly reconciliation: We've prepared a one-paragraph reconciliation note you can attach that states the excess tokens were generated by a staging key replay on 2026-04-17 and that charges applied correspond to that staging key only.

Action items for BrightCart:
1) If you confirm this explanation to AP, please release the invoice hold and we will notate the invoice for internal records.
2) If you prefer a corrective billing credit, reply with an approved PO line or an email approval and we will issue a credit against the April invoice for the replayed tokens (pro rata).

Ben and Lauren have signed off on the export and reconciliation language. I attached: BrightCart_Metering_Snapshot.csv (the original you sent), BrightCart_request_export_apr14-18.csv (our export), and the reconciliation_note.txt.

Let me know which route you'd like and we'll move quickly — if you want the credit, include the PO or approval and we'll queue finance.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: BrightCart_request_export_apr14-18.csv (csv), reconciliation_note.txt (txt)
